{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify the six QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of QA orders identified: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check if they are all in the same channel or segment
print("QA orders by channel:")
print(qa_orders['channel'].value_counts())
print("QA orders by customer_segment:")
print(qa_orders['customer_segment'].value_counts())

# Check if the QA orders are refunded or not
print("QA orders status:")
print(qa_orders['status'].value_counts())

# Check if the QA orders are converted or not
print("QA orders converted:")
print(qa_orders['converted'].value_counts())"}
